notes.title: The Seagull is an upcoming stylized 3D adaption of the classic by Anton Chekhov
notes.notes:
The Seagull, a play by Russian dramatist Anton Chekhov is getting a full stylized 3D adaption from Team Dogpit when it releases later this year.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/06/the-seagull-is-an-upcoming-stylized-3d-adaption-of-the-classic-by-anton-chekhov
